name: PaperLagoon
author: hacha
tagline: Generative environmental music for the FM-1
description: PaperLagoon (working title) is a generative environmental-music firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, after 1980s Japanese kankyō ongaku. It plays by itself; you steer it from outside.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Started from fm1-base's template by Charles Vestal.
